title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
Peter Solomon Ruma, 37, of Vero Beach, was arrested and held on a $1 million bond for allegedly creating and sharing AI-generated sexually explicit images of women without consent. He took photos from social media and other online sources to make the altered images, police said. Investigators searched his home and devices Wednesday and found evidence. Ruma faces eight charges tied to one female victim from June to August 2026, including three counts of creating altered sexual depictions, three counts of promoting them, one count of sexual cyber harassment, and one count of stalking.

Police have identified several additional potential victims who may not know images of them were made or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. The investigation is ongoing, and additional charges could be filed. Anyone who believes they were victimized or has information is urged to contact the Vero Beach Police Department. Victims can also report nonconsensual intimate images through the federal resource TakeItDown.FTC.gov.
